description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Career Change Mode (Ice, Earth, Water) v2], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ward], [Apex Anchor Rain Damage Tracker] and [Apex Anchor Rain Level]

description.name: Career Change Mode (Ice, Earth, Water) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Earth/Water ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ward
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Anchor Rain (0~2), removed after using Apex Anchor Rain two times

description.name: Apex Anchor Rain Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Anchor Rain level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ward]

description.name: Apex Anchor Rain Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Anchor Rain level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ward]
